features: Place ready buildings automatically or through the glowing Buildings tab, and click the active Units tab to smoothly find your newest units.
Added 737 biome-matched city, vegetation, rock and lake sprites with transparent WebP artwork.
SSE detects transparent sources and extracts sprites by alpha contours with adjustable isolation controls.
Villages and towns now use smaller biome-matched homes, with density tapering outward and skylines limited to every fourth settlement.
Desert cities have 20 larger buildings and skyscrapers; units move behind upper floors while their HUDs and selection remain visible.
Grass, soil and snow cities now have larger buildings and skyscrapers with passable upper floors that keep hidden units selectable.
More summer and autumn woodland groups, large lakes and stone formations for grass and soil maps.
Map settings can set lake, tree, vegetation, stone and ground-detail counts.
See a unit's map sprite under the cursor while dragging it from production.
Maps grow denser, irregular forests with clearings, softer edges and occasional isolated trees while keeping roads, bases and resources clear.
improvements: Loading screens now glide over the map background, adapting direction and zoom to your screen.
Cities favor large buildings near their centers and smaller houses toward their edges.
Transparent biome decorations, twice as many shore variations, and separate grass and autumn nature sets.
Removed the three older skyline sheets; cities retain biome-specific village and town buildings.
SSE shows transparent image areas on a dark checkerboard in source, target, and animation views.
Start with balanced mixed biomes, 15 m coastal shallows, more cities and rocks, and music on return visits.
Portrait milestone videos fill the screen width and close when tapped.
Slower tutorial hints, crew recovery tasks, optional extra funds, and Settings and naval Tech Tree guidance.
Guided tutorial narration now uses the existing Atlas Morgan recordings, including touch controls.
City atlases preserve every building's original source resolution with expanded sheets and full-size map footprints.
Sand and snow vegetation, stones, boulders and lakes retain their original source dimensions with larger native-alpha WebP atlases and map footprints.
Pause individual build stacks to continue other production, resume saved progress, and use clearer label-only info cards and direction arrows.
bugfixes: Coastal streets no longer create sandy water gradients.
Old city sprite coordinates are refreshed when loading the replacement atlas.
Ruin props keep dedicated placement sites as the decoration catalog grows.
Fixed SSE tag layout and preserved transparency in new WebP sprite sheets.
Rescaled all new biome, shore and nature props to match existing trees, vehicles and buildings.
Large sand boulders retain placement space on maps with denser rock terrain.
Ground traces now render beneath the shadow of war.
Mines explode when enemy or friendly vehicles cross them, and friendly routes avoid armed mine fields.
Units take the short path through other units and wrecks and push them aside. Buildings still block the way.
Ships follow straighter routes without false dodges, and carriers stop reliably at nearby targets.
Mine layers and mine sweepers drive over their own mines without setting them off.
Tutorial guidance leaves actions to you, waits for narration, and fixes Continue and additive Shift-drag selection.
Portrait milestone videos sit centered below the iPhone safe area.
Wrecks and other movable occupants block new buildings and show invalid placement tiles.
